fact: Decree 2024-073 (Article 11 and Article 13) makes every poor or vulnerable household enrolled in the Registre Social eligible for Tekavoul regular and shock-response cash transfers, within a national quota set by the Government.
Taazour launched on 9 September 2024 its first cash distribution by electronic transfer, in Nouakchott, to Tekavoul families (140,297 families nationally in the regular transfer operation).
